unlisted_practices: Validating a modified System Causability Scale (mSCS) to rate the causability and explainability of LLM treatment recommendations
Delphi consensus to select LLMs and set a non-inferiority margin for comparing LLM recommendations with multidisciplinary tumor board recommendations

screen.reason: The study validates an evaluation scale (System Causability Scale / mSCS) and establishes trial parameters comparing LLM-based urological cancer recommendations with multidisciplinary tumor board decisions on clinical vignettes.
